answer: An applicant cannot sign alone. Its key splits into three shards, two held in vaults run by unrelated established miners. Each epoch the custodians recombine them at a minute the seed picks and seal that answer with a fresh cipher; a custodian co-signs only for wallets it has watched four epochs, forty shards at most, forfeiting a $2,500 bond if two wards land in one sybil cluster. A thousand clones need 2,000 slots, fifty complicit custodians, $125,000 in bonds and $120,000 a month. Willow stakes root only where the bank stays wet; nobody lends you ground and forgets the fence line.
